name: fileparts
expr: [p, n, e] = fileparts('/path/to/archive.tar.gz'); [~, n2, e2] = fileparts('README'); r1 = double(strcmp(p, '/path/to')); r2 = double(strcmp(n, 'archive.tar')); r3 = double(strcmp(e, '.gz')); r4 = double(strcmp(n2, 'README')); r5 = double(isempty(e2));
comment: Sig [path,name,ext]=fileparts(f): splits a path. Multi-dot '/path/to/archive.tar.gz' -> path='/path/to', name='archive.tar' (only the LAST dot starts the extension), ext='.gz'. No-extension 'README' -> name='README', ext='' (empty). strcmp/isempty pin exact string equality (not a loose proxy).
